newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks close up on economic growth optimism.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks close up on economic growth optimism.

text.p: Shares on the Lima Stock Exchange closed higher Friday in busier trade focused on blue-chip stocks as investors bet on improved economic growth for Peru, brokers said.

"At the end of the session there was interest in leading stocks due to investors forecasting positive official figures on the evolution of the country's economy," said Antenor Pacheco of the Macrovalores brokerage.
The General Index rose 0.76 percent to 1,540.85 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index also gained 0.45 percent to 2,218.81 points.
From a total of 92 shares traded, 42 rose, 26 fell and 24 closed unchanged.
In a total of 1,555 trades, volume was estimated at a much improved 39 million soles ($14.9 million), brokers said.
Brokers said the bullish trend would likely continue next week.
Much of the interest, especially from foreign buyers, centered on mining companes, brokers said.
Minsur rose 0.22 percent to 9.02 soles on 245,676 shares, Atacocha rose 1.2 percent to 0.84 soles on 1,049,134 shares and Morococha rose 1.13 percent to 1.79 soles on 165,092 shares.
Benchmark telephone company Telefonica de Peru also gained, rising 0.88 percent to 5.73 soles on 1,011,285 shares.
